fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) is currently trading at a P/E ratio of 46.1x, much higher than the S&P 500's 21.9x, and requires earnings growth of 13.4% or more annually over 6 years at the current share price.
fields.summary_ko.1: The two drugs Mounjaro and Zepbound recorded sales of $16 billion or more in Q3 2026, with only approximately 10% of U.S. patients currently under treatment, suggesting substantial future growth potential.
